data.name: Chetvika
data.gender_notes: Chetvika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Chetvika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chetas' meaning 'consciousness' and 'Vikas' meaning 'growth'. It represents the four directions and symbolizes the growth of consciousness towards enlightenment. The name Chetvika carries the meaning “Four directions, compass” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chetvika usually hope their child will grow to embody four directions, compass and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the expansion of consciousness and spiritual growth towards enlightenment.
data.etymology: Chetvika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Four directions, compass.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chetvika total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
